title: The $D^Δ$-pair biset category
summary: Let $p$ be a prime number. A $D^Δ$-pair is a pair consisting of a finite $p$-group and a $p'$-automorphism of the group. In this paper, we introduce diagonal $D^Δ$-pair bisets and a category whose objects are $D^Δ$-pairs and whose morphism groups are Grothendieck groups of diagonal $D^Δ$-pair bisets. Our main result shows that, over suitable coefficient rings, the category of diagonal $p$-permutation functors is equivalent to the category of linear functors on a natural quotient of this new category.
